latest.title: No more access keys on my laptop: IAM Identity Center for a one-person account
latest.description: I had an admin access key sitting in ~/.aws/credentials on the laptop I carry everywhere. IAM Identity Center and aws sso login replaced it with temporary credentials.

latest.title: AWS IAM: Why Least Privilege Matters in Cloud Security
latest.description: Explore how AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) and the Principle of Least Privilege help strengthen cloud security. Learn how IAM policies restrict unnecessary permissions, reduce security risks, and support secure access to AWS resources through practical examples and best practices.

latest.title: AWS Cost Optimization: How to Reduce Cloud Costs and Improve Efficiency
latest.description: Learn how to reduce Amazon Web Services (AWS) costs using practical cloud cost optimization strategies. Discover how AWS Budgets, Cost Explorer, Auto Scaling, S3 storage classes, and resource monitoring can help businesses save money while maintaining performance and reliability.

latest.title: Getting Started with Amazon EC2: Launch Your First Cloud Server
latest.description: Learn how to launch your first cloud server using Amazon EC2 and explore its key features, including instances, security groups, and key pairs. This beginner-friendly guide walks you through the setup process and helps you understand the fundamentals of cloud computing with AWS.

latest.title: Caching can make an application faster while quietly making its answers outdated.
latest.description: Caching can reduce latency and database load, but outdated responses can create problems that are easy to miss. Explore how caching works, how TTL affects data freshness, and how to make better caching decisions when building applications on AWS.

latest.title: Machine Learning Explained: From Data to Intelligent Predictions
latest.description: Explore how Machine Learning turns raw data into useful predictions, understand its major types, and discover how AWS services can help you build, train, and deploy ML models.

latest.title: Amazon RDS vs. DynamoDB: Choosing the Right Database for Your AWS Application
latest.description: Understand the key differences between Amazon RDS and Amazon DynamoDB, including data modeling, query flexibility, scalability, and cost considerations, to make better database architecture decisions on AWS.

latest.title: PySpark for Beginners: Transforming Data at Scale on AWS
latest.description: Learn how to use PySpark to process and transform data at scale on AWS. In this beginner-friendly guide, we will explore how to read data from Amazon S3, perform data transformations with Python and Apache Spark, and save optimized results in Parquet format. You will also discover practical techniques for building scalable and cost-aware data processing workflows.

latest.title: 把“内心的四种声音”部署到 AWS：基于 AgentCore 与 DeepSeek 的 TimeX 多 Agent 实践
latest.description: 以 TimeX 为例，把事业、探索、生活和健康四个视角拆成一场 multi-agent 议会，并通过 AgentCore Runtime、Gateway 与 Memory 串起工具调用、鉴权和经本人确认的记忆。文中保留代码、阶段性验证和仍需改进的讨论实例。

trending.title: Let's Strands Decider our Role-Playing Game
trending.description:
If you build agents that call tools, you can let them act when they're sure and ask when they're not.
That is the job Strands Decider does. It is a small decision model that answers a typed question (yes/no, pick one, or a score) in a few hundred milliseconds on a laptop.

trending.title: How we ran the Kiro University Challenge as a community build-along: 141 builders at AWS User Group Madurai
trending.description: A community case study and playbook from AWS User Group Madurai. We - Vivek, Logesh and Poobalan turned Kiro's seven-lesson University Challenge into a build-along with four evening Circle sessions, a one-command setup that created a compliant repo and progress tracking, a leaderboard ranked by active days, and community rewards earned by rank. 141 members joined, 77 linked a repo, 38 demonstrated all seven lessons. Includes the numbers, what went wrong, and how to run it without a custom platform.

trending.title: Enterprise-Grade AI Agent Architecture Analysis on AWS: The Synergy of Amazon Bedrock and MCP
trending.description:
After attending AWS Cloud Day in Vietnam, I want to record the valuable insights I gained at the event.

The evolution of Generative AI is rapidly shifting from standalone Large Language Models (LLMs) to autonomous AI Agents capable of reasoning, acting, and interacting directly with enterprise data. This architecture outlines a comprehensive and robust solution on the AWS platform, maximizing the Amazon Bedrock ecosystem in conjunction with the MCP (Model Context Protocol) communication standard.
